title: List the SIFT of a key that is disabled in metadata on the Indexes part
summary: The Indexes part on the Table Information page now lists disabled SIFTs for keys that are disabled in metadata and define SumIndexFields, allowing administrators to enable them.
key_points: Lists disabled SIFT rows for keys disabled in metadata with SumIndexFields
Mirrors existing behavior already implemented for regular indexes
Enables administrators to enable SIFTs on disabled keys through the UI
Platform now supports creating SIFT views and indexes when enabling a SIFT on disabled keys
AL code reading MaintainSIFTIndex sees no behavior change since the Key table remains unchanged
